A1.justification: Both 10-page PDFs describe VGGT-360 and support full comparison of text, equations, figures, tables, and references. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original VGGT-360 benchmark results in Table 1, qualitative comparisons in Figures 7–8, and ablation results in Table 2 and Figures 9–10.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark results, qualitative comparisons, and module and projection ablations reported in Section 4.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same adaptive projection, structure-saliency enhanced attention, and correlation-weighted correction procedures. No model component or inference step changes.

E1.justification: Both evaluate panoramic depth on Matterport3D, Stanford2D3D, and Replica360-2K, with qualitative outdoor evaluation on OmniPhotos. Figure 7 rearranges existing examples without adding dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership within Table 1 is identical. Figures 7–8 retain the same comparisons against 360MD and Depth Anywhere.

E3.justification: The reported evaluation settings, metrics, and backbone configurations are unchanged. Both use eight base views and top-K=2 augmentation; the projection study retains the same parameter ranges.

E4.justification: Table 2 and Figures 9–10 retain identical component ablations and projection accuracy/runtime analyses. Figure 7 reuses the same examples and error maps rather than adding an analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Statistical uncertainty reporting remains unchanged.

E6.justification: Figure 7 swaps the existing predictions, error maps, and ground-truth examples between the unchanged Matterport3D and Stanford2D3D headings, changing their reported dataset attribution. The underlying images, qualitative ranking, and all numerical results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1–9 and their mathematical definitions are identical. No assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about the training-free three-module framework, geometric consistency, comparative performance, and indoor/outdoor zero-shot generalization.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations, generalization interpretations, and accuracy/runtime discussion are unchanged. Both retain the qualification that OmniPhotos comparisons rely on visual plausibility because ground-truth depth is unavailable.

D1.justification: The reported hyperparameters, hardware, backbone choices, runtime information, and code URL are unchanged. No reproducibility details or access instructions are added.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and all 51 references are unchanged, including the positioning relative to view-independent panoramic depth methods and VGGT variants.

P1.justification: The marginal arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 19 March 2026 to v2 dated 14 May 2026. Body wording, headings, captions, and document structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 7 exchanges its first two example groups beneath fixed dataset headings, with slight resizing and associated spacing shifts on page 7. Other figure and table content is unchanged.

improvement.justification: The only potentially substantive revision is Figure 7's changed dataset attribution. The supplied PDFs do not independently establish which assignment is correct, so this could correct or introduce a labeling error. Methods, numerical evidence, and exposition otherwise remain unchanged, preventing a reliable judgment of net improvement.
